scripts.build:renderer: LICKETYSPLIT_DESKTOP=1 pnpm --filter @licketysplit/web build && pnpm --filter @licketysplit/web exec vite build --config vite.migration.config.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:main
scripts.pack: pnpm run fetch:ffmpeg && pnpm run build && node scripts/write-source-receipt.mjs && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: pnpm run fetch:ffmpeg && pnpm run build && node scripts/write-source-receipt.mjs && electron-builder
